implementation: Diversinet Java Crypto Module for Mobile
description: Diversinet Java Crypto Module for Mobile is shipped with Diversinet MobiSecure Client SDK for Java based run-time environments on Smartphones and tablets including, Android OS-, BlackBerry OS- and Java ME MIDP-based. The Crypto Module implements several cryptography algorithms including Triple DES, AES, SHA, HMAC, DRBG and RSA.
